answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation is a task of automatically producing text from non‑linguistic input ... we manually evaluate several representative models ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions generated from structured data

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate models' performance using automatic metric BLEU, and the BLEU scores are comparable to the mainstream research.

answer_4.quote: We hire five annotators ... Each annotator must label all the five outputs generated by five models of one input sequence ... Through human evaluation similar to PolyTope we further analyze and evaluate the performance of the models on different datasets.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators locate every error, assign an error type (evidence of accuracy or fluency) and a severity (Minor, Major, Critical) according to the MQM framework.
